title: Katt Williams Was Sure He’d Be Dead by Now
summary: He may be best known for his scorching viral takedowns, but the comic has been filling arenas and making headlines for decades. As memoir ‘Nine Lives, No Wives, and 69 Concubines' hits shelves, Williams opens up about his new podcast, his epic beefs and past legal troubles, and why he always felt like his life was a race against time.
